blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY, Philippines — The province of Benguet will celebrate its 126th founding anniversary with a Grand Cañao on Monday, Nov. 23, bringing together communities to honor the province’s cultural heritage, traditions and the spirit of Adivay. Gov. Melchor Diclas invited residents to join the celebration, describing the Grand Cañao as an occasion to honor Benguet’s rich heritage and embrace the spirit of Adivay, an Ibaloi term associated with coming together. READ: ‘Adivay’: From clan gathering to Benguet feast The celebration will also highlight the unity of Benguet’s communities and their shared efforts to preserve the province’s cultural identity and traditions.
